skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Bedtime Story
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bedtime Story. Brigid's 'housewear' she chose for herself. Even if there's rarely a warm room to enjoy oneself in, it can still grant the hasty a moment of calm.
skins.quote: All of her bedtime stories are similar to the ones she's heard before. After you listen to them, your dreams tonight might end up showing you the same sights she's seen during her travels.
